name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC SLX 800
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC SLX 800
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC SLX 800 ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 400C. Federung: Fox 38 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 170mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Performance, 230x65mm, Adjustable LSR w/ 2-Pos. Lever. Schaltung: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake (200/200). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC SLX 800 is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 400C. Suspension: Fox 38 Float Performance GRIP, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 170mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X Performance, 230x65mm, Adjustable LSR w/ 2-Pos. Lever. Drivetrain: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8220, Hydr. Disc Brake (200/200). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
motorDetails: Bosch Drive Unit Performance Line CX max. 120Nm (BDU38)
